class.name: mujoco_dock_sim_plugin/DockSimPlugin
class.description: Simulates docking between pairs of MuJoCo sites by driving a pool of weld equality constraints. Interfaces are grouped; a dock is only allowed between two sites of the same group (and, when the group defines male_sites / female_sites, only between a male and a female site). A dock succeeds when the two sites' relative pose stays within the group's tolerance of the group's docking relative pose for the configured dock time, after which the weld is activated and the pair is locked. Release deactivates the weld after the configured release time. Both operations are offered as services (~/dock, ~/release) and as actions (~/dock, ~/release).
